p0_seams.rationale: test_bridge_to_sdk_to_mcp_refusal_trace_roundtrip constructs a bridge-like trace context with trace_id, creates an SDK RigRefusal, passes to evaluate_mcp_request with an unknown tool name, validates the MCP refusal against rig.relay.mcp.refusal.v1 schema, and asserts trace_id is preserved. test_cross_surface_roundtrip_no_raw_payload_echoed performs adversarial content-light sweep confirming no raw tokens, secrets, paths, or prompts appear in the output JSON.

Agent A produced docs/json/governance/refusal_vocabulary_v1.v1.json and docs/schemas/rig.relay.refusal_vocabulary.v1.schema.json with 29 shared refusal classes, 71 surface mapping entries, and 10 surfaces mapped. 48 tests pass validating schema conformance, shared class coverage, surface completeness, and content-light enforcement. The vocabulary artifact is validated against its schema and all required assertion tests pass.

Agent B extended 4 schemas (github_provider.operation_receipt.v1, google_workspace.operation_receipt.v1, rig.ci.run.v1, rig.ci.verdict.v1) with optional trace_id/receipt_id/evidence_id fields. GitHub receipt builder (build_github_operation_receipt) and Google Workspace receipt builder accept trace_id and auto-generate receipt_id. CI evidence producer (_build_run_evidence) accepts trace_id/correlation_id and populates them in the run evidence. test_provider_receipt_carries_trace_id_joinable verifies the GitHub receipt carries the matching trace_id and validates against the schema. test_ci_evidence_carries_correlation_id verifies CI run evidence carries matching correlation_id. 6 new tests pass, 169 regression pass.

Agent C created rig_relay/protocols/mcp/_refusal_adapter.py with evaluate_mcp_request() (produces schema-valid refusal envelopes for unknown, mutation, credentialed, and destructive tier tools) and classify_tool_descriptor_suspicious() (adversarial descriptor metadata detection). 19 tests in test_mcp_runtime_refusals_v1.py cover: unknown tool refusal, mutation tier refusal, open-world tier refusal, credentialed mutation refusal, destructive tier refusal, read-only tool allowance, descriptor classification (name mismatch, dual-hint shadowing, read-only claim for destructive, oversized description, foreign capability), malformed request handling, empty tool name, all 5 MCPToolTier values, and adversarial coverage.

Agent D created rig_relay/acp/_refusal_adapter.py with build_acp_refusal() and raise_acp_refusal(). authenticate() and resume_session() now produce schema-valid ACP refusal envelopes instead of bare NotImplementedMethodError. 20 tests in test_acp_schema_refusal_adapter_v1.py cover: refusal envelope construction, schema validation, trace_id preservation, content_light enforcement, refusal Error raising, session_id tracking, method field accuracy, and refusal_code/flow consistency. test_sdk_to_acp_refusal_trace_roundtrip confirms cross-surface trace_id survives SDK→ACP adapter path.

trace_roundtrip_result.detail: test_bridge_to_sdk_to_mcp_refusal_trace_roundtrip proves trace_id='trace-test-v1-abc123def456' survives the full bridge→SDK→MCP refusal path. Bridge-like trace context (trace_id, parent_message_id, frontend_session_id, backend_session_id) is constructed, SDK RigRefusal model produces a schema-valid refusal, evaluate_mcp_request with unknown tool name produces a schema-valid MCP refusal envelope (validated against rig.relay.mcp.refusal.v1 schema), and trace_id is preserved end-to-end. test_cross_surface_roundtrip_no_raw_payload_echoed confirms no raw tokens, secrets, paths, or prompts are echoed in the output JSON.

Schema at docs/schemas/rig.relay.refusal_vocabulary.v1.schema.json enforces class coverage, surface completeness, and content_light invariant. 48 tests pass including schema validation, class enumeration, surface mapping completeness, and adversarial no-forbidden-field tests. The vocabulary is append-only and content-light.

provider_ci_joinability_result.detail: Agent B extended 4 provider/CI schemas with optional trace_id/receipt_id/evidence_id fields. GitHub and Google Workspace receipt builders accept trace_id param and auto-generate receipt_id. CI evidence producer (_build_run_evidence and produce_ci_evidence) accept trace_id and correlation_id. test_provider_receipt_carries_trace_id_joinable builds a GitHub operation receipt with trace_id='trace-test-v1-abc123def456', validates against rig.github_provider.operation_receipt.v1 schema, and confirms trace_id is carried through. test_ci_evidence_carries_correlation_id builds CI run evidence with correlation_id='corr-cross-surface-v1-1-001' and confirms it is carried. 6 new tests pass, 169 regression pass.

mcp_runtime_refusal_result.detail: Agent C created MCP refusal adapter at rig_relay/protocols/mcp/_refusal_adapter.py with evaluate_mcp_request() producing schema-valid refusal envelopes for unknown, mutation-tier, credentialed, and destructive tools. classify_tool_descriptor_suspicious() provides adversarial descriptor metadata detection (name mismatch, dual-hint shadowing, oversized description, foreign capabilities). 19 tests in test_mcp_runtime_refusals_v1.py cover all refusal paths and adversarial conditions. All tests pass.

The two alpha blockers identified in the convergence review (MCP zero tests and ACP live NotImplementedMethodError stubs) are now resolved.
